mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, email, created_date FROM users WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND created_date >= SYSDATE - 30 ORDER BY username

SELECT user_id, username, manager_id, LEVEL as hierarchy_level, SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(username, '/') as path FROM users <include refid="oracle_examples\UserMapper_getUserHierarchy_hierarchical"/>
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( user_id, username, email, created_date, status ) VALUES ( user_seq.<include refid="oracle_examples\UserMapper_insertUser_sequence"/>, #{username}, #{email}, SYSDATE, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select: SELECT department_id, department_name, LISTAGG(username, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY username) as user_list, COUNT(*) as user_count FROM users u JOIN departments d ON u.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY department_id, department_name
